description: Can AI answer engines like ChatGPT search, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini read and cite a website? Checks what the site controls: robots.txt rules for their crawlers, whether the door lets them in, whether the content is in the HTML or needs JavaScript, title and description, structured data, llms.txt and sitemap. Free. Also known as an AEO or GEO check. It reports facts; it can't promise an AI will mention a site.
name: ai_visibility_check
title: AI visibility check (AEO)
